metadata.name: salesforce_marketing_cloud__sends_links
metadata.comment: Each record represents a link and the corresponding send(s).

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The record's source if the unioning functionality is used. Otherwise this field will be empty.

bcc_email.name: bcc_email
bcc_email.comment: Indicates email addresses to receive blind carbon copy of a message.

duplicates.name: duplicates
duplicates.comment: Represent the number of duplicate email addresses associated with a send (exists only when a send occurs to multiple lists).

email_name.name: email_name
email_name.comment: Specifies the name of an email message associated with a send.

existing_undeliverables.name: existing_undeliverables
existing_undeliverables.comment: Indicates whether bounces occurred on previous send.

existing_unsubscribes.name: existing_unsubscribes
existing_unsubscribes.comment: Indicates whether unsubscriptions occurred on previous send.

forwarded_emails.name: forwarded_emails
forwarded_emails.comment: Number of emails forwarded for a send.

from_address.name: from_address
from_address.comment: Indicates From address associated with a object. Deprecated for email send definitions and triggered send definitions.

from_name.name: from_name
from_name.comment: Specifies the default email message From Name. Deprecated for email send definitions and triggered send definitions.

hard_bounces.name: hard_bounces
hard_bounces.comment: Indicates number of hard bounces associated with a send.

invalid_addresses.name: invalid_addresses
invalid_addresses.comment: Specifies the number of invalid addresses associated with a send.

is_always_on.name: is_always_on
is_always_on.comment: Indicates whether the request can be performed while the system is is maintenance mode. A value of true indicates that the system processes the request.

is_multipart.name: is_multipart
is_multipart.comment: Indicates whether the email is sent with Multipart/MIME enabled.

missing_addresses.name: missing_addresses
missing_addresses.comment: Specifies number of missing addresses encountered within a send.

number_delivered.name: number_delivered
number_delivered.comment: Number of sent emails that did not bounce.

number_errored.name: number_errored
number_errored.comment: Number of emails not sent as part of a send because an error occurred while trying to build the email.

number_excluded.name: number_excluded
number_excluded.comment: Indicates the number recipients excluded from an email send because of a held, unsubscribed, master unsubscribed, or global unsubscribed status.

number_sent.name: number_sent
number_sent.comment: Number of emails actually sent as part of an email send. This number reflects all of the sent messages and may include bounced messages.

number_targeted.name: number_targeted
number_targeted.comment: Indicates the number of possible recipients for an email send. This number does not include unsubscribed or excluded subscribers for a given list or data extension.

other_bounces.name: other_bounces
other_bounces.comment: Specifies number of Other-type bounces in a send.

preview_url.name: preview_url
preview_url.comment: Indicates URL used to preview the message associated with a send.

soft_bounces.name: soft_bounces
soft_bounces.comment: Indicates number of soft bounces associated with a specific send.

subject.name: subject
subject.comment: Contains subject area information for a message.

unique_opens.name: unique_opens
unique_opens.comment: Indicates number of unique opens resulting from a triggered send.

unsubscribes.name: unsubscribes
unsubscribes.comment: Indicates the number of unsubscribe events associated with a send.

send_created_date.name: send_created_date
send_created_date.comment: Indicates the time the object was created.

send_modified_date.name: send_modified_date
send_modified_date.comment: Indicates the last time object information was modified.

send_date.name: send_date
send_date.comment: Indicates the date on which a send occurred. Set this value to have a CST (Central Standard Time) value.

link_alias.name: link_alias
link_alias.comment: Name of link contained in message.

link_total_clicks.name: link_total_clicks
link_total_clicks.comment: Indicates total number of clicks on link in message.

link_url.name: link_url
link_url.comment: Indicates URL included in an event or configuration.

link_last_clicked.name: link_last_clicked
link_last_clicked.comment: Indicates last time a link included in a message was clicked.

metadata.name: stg_salesforce_marketing_cloud__triggered_send
metadata.comment: Each record represents a triggered send.

source_relation.name: source_relation
source_relation.comment: The record's source if the unioning functionality is used. Otherwise this field will be empty.

triggered_send_id.name: triggered_send_id
triggered_send_id.comment: Unique identifier of the triggered send.

auto_add_subscribers.name: auto_add_subscribers
auto_add_subscribers.comment: Indicates whether a triggered send recipient is added to a subscriber list.

auto_update_subscribers.name: auto_update_subscribers
auto_update_subscribers.comment: Indicates if any subscriber information is updated as part of a triggered send.

bcc_email.name: bcc_email
bcc_email.comment: Indicates email addresses to receive blind carbon copy of a message.

created_date.name: created_date
created_date.comment: Indicates the time the object was created.

modified_date.name: modified_date
modified_date.comment: Indicates the last time object information was modified.

triggered_send_description.name: triggered_send_description
triggered_send_description.comment: Describes and provides information regarding the object.

dynamic_email_subject.name: dynamic_email_subject
dynamic_email_subject.comment: Contains content to be used in a dynamic subject line.

email_subject.name: email_subject
email_subject.comment: Contains subject area information for a message.

from_address.name: from_address
from_address.comment: Indicates From address associated with a object. Deprecated for email send definitions and triggered send definitions.

from_name.name: from_name
from_name.comment: Specifies the default email message From Name. Deprecated for email send definitions and triggered send definitions.

is_multipart.name: is_multipart
is_multipart.comment: Indicates whether the email is sent with Multipart/MIME enabled.

is_wrapped.name: is_wrapped
is_wrapped.comment: Indicates whether an email send contains the links necessary to process tracking information for clicks.

priority.name: priority
priority.comment: Defines the priority for a triggered send. Valid values include Low, Medium, and High.

send_limit.name: send_limit
send_limit.comment: Indicates limit of messages to send as part of a send definition within a predefined send window.

send_window_close.name: send_window_close
send_window_close.comment: Defines the end of a send window for a send definition.

send_window_open.name: send_window_open
send_window_open.comment: Defines the beginning of a send window for a send definition.
